picks.file: William Cowen (1791-1864) - View of Bradford - 188-1920 - Cartwright Hall Art Gallery.jpg
picks.what: View of Bradford, painting (Cartwright Hall Art Gallery, Bradford)
picks.why: color general view of the mill town with its chimneys; firm date

picks.what: The city center with the City Hall clock tower, photograph
picks.why: rooftop view over the center; City Hall tower recognizable

gaps: P0–P2: no candidates. P4: no real candidates (the ‘Bradford’ hits are prints by the American lithographers Tappan & Bradford and a Country Press book page). P5: nothing.
notes: P3 alternative: John Wilson Anderson’s ‘View of Bradford’ (about 1825–33; #1 and #2 are two photos of the same painting, #1 the better one) shows the parish church tower more clearly; only 20 years from Cowen, so one was kept. #11 is Ilkley Town Hall, not Bradford.
